Name: Unlock BFF Houses
Author: Pasca1409
Description:
[left][/left]
[left][b][u][size=4][font=Arial Black]Description[/font][/size][/u][/b][/left]
We all know the feeling: you are best friends with a villager, but you find yourself standing in front of a locked door late at night or early in the morning. With "Unlock BFF Houses", this is a thing of the past!
This mod dynamically unlocks NPC houses for you as soon as you have reached a specific friendship level (hearts) with them. You will never have to wait outside for hours just to give your favourite NPC a gift again.

[size=4][font=Arial Black][b][u]Installation[/u][/b][/font][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*][i](Optional, but highly recommended)[/i] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily adjust the mod settings in-game.[/*]
[*]Download the "Unlock BFF Houses" archive and extract it.[/*]
[*]Move the extracted folder into your
Stardew Valley/Mods
folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4][font=Arial Black]Main features[/font][/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Dynamic house access:[/b] Villagers' doors can be opened as soon as you reach the required friendship level.[/*]
[*][b]Key Ring Menu:[/b] Press the default key "K" to open a neat in-game menu that shows you whose houses you have access to. The menu visually displays all unlocked friends.[/*]
[*][b]Fully configurable:[/b] Using the [i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i], you can easily adjust the required amount of hearts (from 0 to 14) and the hotkey for the key ring menu directly in the game. The default requirement is set to 8 hearts.[/*]
[*][b]Resident recognition:[/b] When you enter a house, the game displays a message telling you whose key was used. If multiple unlocked characters live in the same house, they are intelligently grouped together (e.g., "A, B & C").[/*]
[*][b]Translation ready:[/b] The mod uses i18n files and can easily be translated into different languages.[/*]
[/list]Supported Languages
Currently, the mod includes translations for:
[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]German[/*]
[/list][i](If you would like to contribute a translation for your native language, you can easily do so by creating a new file in the [/i][i]"i18n" f[/i][i]older. Feel free to send it to me, and I will include it in the next update!)[/i]
